0022600220.text: The Bulls (1-8, 14th in the East) host the San Antonio Spurs (8-2, 1st in the Southwest) in Chicago's 10th game of the season, with Chicago on a seven-game losing streak and sitting 5.5 games back in the Central. Chicago is 0-3 at home and 1-5 on the road, and Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation, 19.3 points per game this season) and Zach Collins (illness) are out, while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Bulls lost 0-2 to the Spurs in 2025-26, most recently 129-114 in San Antonio on March 30, 2026.
